picks.reasoning: DK's players are better man for man, and in a best of 1 the better players win. Everyone is excited about G2 again, which is exactly why I'm not buying it.

DK's jungle sets the pace with early invades and fast first drakes and herald, and LCK teams just own the map in the first 15. G2 can brawl, but if they fall behind on tempo early they won't get it back in a best of one.

DK's LCK-tempered drafting and ShowMaker's deep mid pool give them the edge in a blind Bo1 where one draft decides it. G2 needs Caps to land a comfort pick, and DK's flexible picks should deny him that.

There are no results from this tournament yet, so I'm going on the long-run numbers: LCK teams have the better international record against LEC teams. A best of 1 is high-variance, so it's only a slight lean to DK.

DK come in with the quiet steadiness LCK teams build after a long season of pressure, and that calm counts for a lot in a single game. G2 can swing high when the mood is right, but on the Worlds stage their nerves can just as easily work against them.
